correctness.rationale: Soundness of the published Bullet type isomorphism yields D isomorphic to E^D. Exhausting E as empty, singleton, or containing two distinct elements proves that a solution exists exactly when both E and D are singletons; the power-set injection and Cantor theorem cover every finite or infinite non-singleton case.

originality.rationale: The classical D isomorphic to D^D cardinal obstruction is explicitly treated as background. The checked source and targeted literature/published-finding corpus searches did not state the generalized D isomorphic to E^D classification or its empty-falsity and Bullet-star consequences for these 2026 calculi.

value.rationale: The result isolates an exact semantic boundary for the new Bullet systems: ordinary full-function Set semantics either collapses to terminal denotations or fails altogether for empty falsity, explaining why a nontrivial computational semantics must use a different function-space notion or semantic category.
